notes.title: Version 1.07 & Halloween Sale
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

A quick update today to coincide with the Steam Halloween sale which is due to start this evening. 

Crimson Hotel will be 20% off until November 1st!

Alongside this sale we've got a visual update with a shader change, several lighting improvements and a complete redoing of the post-processing. 

Expect news on the VR update very shortly!

Happy Halloween

notes.title: Update 1.06 Live
notes.notes:
Hi all,

Very small update today to address some connectivity issues around inviting other players to your game. We're hoping that this makes things a bit more stable but please share your feedback regardless!

Spire Interactive

notes.title: Update 1.05 Live - Japanese language support
notes.notes:
Hi all,

Quick (and for us quite exciting) update tonight that adds support for Japanese to Crimson Hotel.

Upon launching the game players with their Steam language set to Japanese should have their game automatically translated, and you can also change your language preference from the options menu.

If there are any languages that you think we should look at including then please comment either here or in the discussions and we'll try our best. 

Spire Interactive

notes.title: Update 1.04 Live
notes.notes:
Hi all, 

Another update today with some changes and fixes.


Updated engine to Unity 2019. This will help with VR functionality amongst other things.
Fixed another issue causing the tall lady to get stuck in the lobby area.
Added some new visual effects.
Dialled down the brightness on a certain hair texture even further.
Added some new audio effects.


Thanks! As always we'd love to hear any feedback or criticism as it helps us go forward.

Spire Interactive

notes.title: Update 1.03
notes.notes:
Hi all,

A quick update today with some fixes including:

- The tall lady should no longer get stuck on certain doorways. 
- The UI now displays collected keys. 
- Pickups now have a very faint overlay on them to make them slightly easier to spot.
- Fixed a collision issue in the upstairs lobby. 
- Added a not unrelated plaque to the upstairs lobby. 
- Added a couple of new random encounters. 
- Fixed a hair texture issue. 

The VR branch will receive a similar update very shortly with a few more VR-specific fixes.

Thanks!

Spire Interactive

notes.title: Update 1.02 Live
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

A quick update today to fix a few things and introduce a few others.


 Fixed AI getting stuck in certain places
 Lighting changed in certain areas
 Fixed an issue where the drowned boy would continue moving on the stairs if in view
 Added short animated sequences for both victory & defeat conditions
 More small optimisations and changes to postprocessing


As always we'd love to hear any feedback that you may have.

Thank you!

Spire Interactive

notes.title: Very small hotfix
notes.notes:
Hi all,

Further to the last announcement: we're putting out a very small hotfix tonight with some tweaks to enemy speed and also a fix for one of the AI getting stuck.

It should be live any minute.

Thanks!

notes.title: Singleplayer Balance Changes
notes.notes:
Hi all,

Just a quick message to say that we're aware of singleplayer being a little too difficult right now and we're looking into it - it's on our radar for a fix soon.

Thanks!

notes.title: Various fixes - Patch 1.01
notes.notes:
Hi all,

We've got a few fixes for some bugs that popped up today.


 The drowned boy should no longer attack you when he is frozen
 Various AI navigation improvements - we'll let you discover the rest :)
 Slight optimisations made across the level


Please let us know if you find any other bugs and we'll get onto them as soon as we can. We hope you're enjoying everything so far!

Spire Interactive
